prompt.asset_type: complete 2:1 open-source launch poster including integrated typography
prompt.primary_request: Create the Signal Terminal visual direction for pulsecheck, a cli described as: Know what is up before your users do. Depict a compact command-line monitoring instrument built from pulse traces, status nodes, and modular terminal-like planes.
prompt.style: tactile terminal instrumentation, luminous signal traces, crisp technical editorial art
prompt.composition: asymmetric 5-column poster grid; project name integrated into the left-center instrument panel; monitoring instrument occupies the right two-thirds; small category label, dominant product name, quiet one-line promise. Treat typography, shapes, texture, and subject as one authored composition—not artwork with a text box placed on top.
prompt.text: Render exactly these two lines and no other readable copy: "pulsecheck" and "Know what is up before your users do." Spell every character verbatim.
prompt.typography: Custom display typography that belongs to the visual concept; strong hierarchy, editorial spacing, crisp readable letterforms, no generic centered SaaS banner
prompt.constraints: No extra words, fake interface labels, code, logos, badges, watermarks, people, third-party marks, generic gradient blobs, or text floating inside a plain overlay panel
